clue.text: Before opening of dump litter is turned away

indicators.note: before says the rubbish word comes ahead of the next piece

parts.note: litter is rubbish, which is refuse

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter, here of dump

explanation.surface: Rubbish is rejected before it reaches the tip.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who was refused was rejected or sent away.

clue.text: A cheese needed for game starting off outside

indicators.note: the shortened game wraps around the word for
the game's name loses its starting letter

parts.note: croquet is a lawn game played with mallets and hoops
taken as written

explanation.surface: A cheese is required to start a game outdoors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starting off' removes the first letter of the game, leaving ROQUET (a croquet stroke); 'outside' means that shortened word goes around the other piece. 'needed for' reads as a link, but 'for' supplies letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Roquefort is a French blue cheese made from ewe's milk.

clue.text: Removed coat to be taken to the cleaners

definitions.meaning: a sheep shorn of its wool has had its coat taken off
slang for swindled or robbed of money

explanation.definitionFit: Shearing strips a sheep's wool, and to be swindled is also to be shorn.

clue.text: Veronica runs away from drunken party to be at home?

indicators.note: the runs letter goes away from the party word

parts.note: a spree is a bout of drinking or revelry
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
to dwell is to live somewhere, to be at home there

explanation.surface: Veronica slips away from a boozy party to stay home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'away from' removes R from SPREE, leaving SPEE.
explanation.definitionFit: Veronica is the botanical genus of the small blue-flowered plant called speedwell.

clue.text: Small amounts of flounders, for example

definitions.meaning: the dab is a flatfish, like the flounder

explanation.definitionFit: Light touches leave little portions, and dab is a kind of flatfish akin to flounder.

clue.text: A bit of an ass, this biblical slayer

definitions.text: A bit of an ass, this biblical slayer

parts.words: A bit of an ass, this biblical slayer
parts.note: in the Book of Judges Samson killed a thousand Philistines with part of a donkey's skull

explanation.surface: A rather foolish person is described as a killer from the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Samson's weapon was the lower jaw of a donkey, a part of an ass.

clue.text: Makeshift panel tampered with

parts.note: a jury is a panel of citizens judging a case
rigged means fixed dishonestly

explanation.surface: A jury panel has been nobbled.
explanation.definitionFit: Something improvised from whatever is to hand is a temporary, makeshift arrangement.

clue.text: Shawls in box wife picked up

indicators.note: in a down clue, picked up means the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: to spar is to box

explanation.surface: Shawls are in a box that a wife collected.
explanation.definitionFit: Shawls are garments worn draped around the shoulders, as are wraps.

clue.text: Nothing to be binding in this judgement

parts.note: O, the zero shape, means nothing
to pinion is to bind someone's arms

explanation.surface: Nothing is binding in this legal ruling.
explanation.definitionFit: A judge's opinion is the formal judgement given in a case.

clue.text: His draws always turn out to be winners

definitions.text: His draws always turn out to be winners

parts.words: His draws always turn out to be winners
parts.note: the British Premium Bond prize machine picks only winning numbers in each draw

explanation.surface: A lucky man whose every raffle ticket wins.
explanation.walkthrough: ERNIE is the random-number machine that picks Premium Bond prize winners in Britain (Premium Bonds are a state savings lottery); every number it draws wins.
explanation.definitionFit: The bond machine's draws select prizewinners, so every one is a winner.

clue.text: Question brief announcement of train

indicators.note: an announcement is spoken, so the letter is heard rather than seen

parts.note: Q is the short form of question

explanation.surface: A query about a short announcement concerning a railway train.
explanation.definitionFit: A train of people waiting one behind another is a line.

clue.text: Girl short with chap belonging to rugger club

indicators.note: the name is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: Barbara is a girl's name
Ian is a man's name

explanation.surface: A girl is lacking a man in a rugby club.
explanation.walkthrough: The Barbarians are a famous invitation rugby union club; a player selected for it is one of them.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the Barbarians invitation rugby side is called by the club's singular name.

clue.text: Disguise one,s writing in enclosed poem

parts.note: Enc is the abbreviation written on letters with something enclosed
an ode is a lyric poem

explanation.surface: Someone hides their writing inside a poem in a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To put a message in cipher is to disguise it from readers.

clue.text: Priest working, for example, to back reputation

indicators.note: working suggests the letters of priest are set in motion and rearranged
to back means the abbreviation is turned backwards

explanation.surface: A priest at work backs up his good name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'working' rearranges PRIEST into PRESTI; 'to back' turns EG into GE.
explanation.definitionFit: Prestige is the standing and esteem someone enjoys.

clue.text: Inform on Jack as a thief

parts.note: to shop someone is British slang for informing on them
a jack is a device for lifting a car

explanation.surface: Someone grasses up Jack as a robber.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jack' looks like a man's name but is the car jack, a lifter.
explanation.definitionFit: A shoplifter is someone who steals goods from stores.

clue.text: Senior citizen job centre left to fade away

indicators.note: the centre letter of job is taken

parts.note: to die away is to fade

explanation.surface: An older person has been left by the job centre to wither away.
explanation.definitionFit: An oldie is informal for an elderly person.

clue.text: Larks making deceptive turns aloft

parts.note: aloft means high up
jinks are quick dodging turns

explanation.surface: Skylarks swerve high in the sky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Larks' looks like the birds, which fits 'aloft', but means fun.
explanation.definitionFit: Larks are boisterous pranks, and high jinks is boisterous fun.

clue.text: Cheerful quality appropriate to a marine?

definitions.meaning: Jolly is old naval slang for a Royal Marine, so the quality of being one

explanation.definitionFit: Merriness is good cheer, and the joke reads it as the condition of being a marine nicknamed a Jolly.

clue.text: Dump old crate here

definitions.meaning: a dump is a pile of discarded rubbish
a crate is slang for an old car, which ends up on a pile of scrap

explanation.definitionFit: A pile of discarded junk is where a worn-out car, an old crate, is thrown.

clue.text: Designed ample set including one type of photography

indicators.note: the rearranged letters take in the letter for one
designed means the letters of ample set are laid out anew

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An ample photographic set has been designed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Designed' rearranges AMPLE SET into TMELAPSE; 'including' puts I after the T.
explanation.definitionFit: Time-lapse photography takes frames at intervals to speed up slow change.

clue.text: Factor in many a battle

indicators.note: the factor word goes inside the letters for many a

parts.note: M, a thousand in Roman numerals, stands for many
a factor is an agent who acts for another

explanation.surface: An element is present in many a battle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Factor' looks like a cause but is an agent acting for someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Magenta in Lombardy gave its name to an 1859 battle of the Second Italian War of Independence.

clue.text: Camp, say, where you can park for a drink

indicators.note: say means the camp word is spoken

parts.note: a laager is a camp ringed by wagons

explanation.surface: A campsite with parking also sells beer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'where you can park' describes the laager, a South African camp of wagons drawn up in a circle.
explanation.definitionFit: Lager is a light beer, a kind of alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Knight wearing glittering decoration

indicators.note: the knight wears the bright word around him

parts.note: garish means gaudily bright
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: A knight is dressed in gleaming ornament.
explanation.definitionFit: A garnish is an ornamental trimming added to food.

clue.text: Where the traveller may get out in France?

definitions.text: Where the traveller may get out in France?

parts.words: Where the traveller may get out in France?
parts.note: on a French train one can lie down and sleep, stretching out, in a sleeping carriage

explanation.surface: A tourist asks where to disembark in France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get out' suggests leaving the train; read as stretching out to sleep in a French sleeper car.
explanation.definitionFit: A wagon-lit is a sleeping car on a continental European train.

clue.text: Noisy exercise in wooded area

indicators.note: noisy means the word is heard spoken

parts.note: to wield power is to exercise it

explanation.surface: Loud workouts are held in the woods.
explanation.walkthrough: The Weald is a once-wooded region of south-east England.
explanation.definitionFit: A weald is an old word for forest or wooded country.

clue.text: Have some shown a talent from birth?

indicators.note: have some means some of the letters of shown a talent are taken

explanation.surface: Has someone shown talent since being born?
explanation.definitionFit: Natal describes what relates to or dates from birth.

clue.text: Stripe could be assessment of military status

indicators.note: could be means the letters of stripe might become another word

explanation.surface: A soldier's stripe might show rank.
explanation.walkthrough: A sitrep is a military situation report.
explanation.definitionFit: A sitrep, short for situation report, sums up the current position of forces.

clue.text: Make new effort to go up river

indicators.note: in a down clue, going up means reading backwards

parts.note: to redo is to make a fresh attempt

explanation.surface: Trying again to travel upstream.
explanation.definitionFit: The Oder is a river forming part of the German-Polish border.

clue.text: Added notes, changing to andante

indicators.note: changing means the letters of to andante are rearranged

explanation.surface: Musical notes are added, switching the tempo to andante.
explanation.definitionFit: To annotate a text is to add explanatory notes.

clue.text: Sending-off from English team the Spanish overturned

parts.note: XI, eleven, is a football or cricket team

indicators.note: overturned means the Spanish word is turned backwards

parts.note: el is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: A player sent off from an English team for upending a Spaniard.
explanation.definitionFit: Exile is banishment, a sending away from one's country.

clue.text: I speak slowly at first, looking into gift, perhaps, when retiring

indicators.note: the letter goes into the reversed gift word
retiring means moving backwards, so the gift word is reversed

parts.note: a reward may take the form of a gift

indicators.note: the first letter of looking is taken

explanation.surface: Someone speaks slowly, examining a present before going to bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when retiring' turns REWARD into DRAWER; 'into' puts L inside, giving DRAW-L-ER.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawler is a person who talks in a slow, drawn-out way.

clue.text: Girl informed about source of vitamin c

parts.note: Rose is a girl's name
hip means in the know, informed

explanation.surface: A girl is told about where to get vitamin C.
explanation.definitionFit: The rosehip, fruit of the rose, is rich in ascorbic acid and used in syrups.
